_doc: M11 (Tools/feel-metrics.py): the ui[] paths allowed to use each colour token, as plain string prefixes ('UI/HUD sight/Points pop ' allows Points pop 0..9). Filled by the lead at the baseline (build 1's reel, NIGHT18 09:40) from 'roles <reel> --suggest', keeping only CLAUDE.md rule 8's roles: GOLD for points only; DANGER for enemies and danger only (the hurt vignette, the damage-direction markers, DOWN's head); RIVAL for RIVAL only. Left out on purpose: 'Dash tint/left', 'Dash tint/bottom' (DANGER on the player's own boost) and 'UI/HUD sight/Kill marker' (NIGHT17's kill marker in DANGER; NIGHT18's is white).
